meta.promptText: Which vitamin C serum should I buy for dark spots and dull skin in India?

response.text:
For **dark spots + dull skin**, I’d prioritize a **well-formulated 10–15% vitamin C serum** rather than automatically choosing the highest percentage. L-ascorbic acid is the most studied form, while stable derivatives such as ethyl ascorbic acid are generally easier to tolerate and store in India’s heat/humidity. [phdbeauty.com](https://phdbeauty.com/blogs/general-advice/best-vitamin-c-serum-india-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.vogue.in](https://www.vogue.in/content/the-7-best-vitamin-c-serums-for-an-even-toned-complexion?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks

**🥇 Best overall for most people: Minimalist 10% Vitamin C**
### [Minimalist Face Serum]()
*₹269*

- Good beginner-friendly strength
- Uses **10% ethyl ascorbic acid**
- Better choice if you're concerned about irritation
- Particularly sensible for uneven tone and post-acne marks. [www.pingmedoc.com](https://www.pingmedoc.com/pharmacy/buying-guides/best-vitamin-c-serum?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🥈 If your skin already tolerates vitamin C: Plum 15% Vitamin C**
### [Plum 15% Vitamin C Face Serum Mandarin]()
*₹456*

- 15% strength gives you a step up from a 10% serum
- Good option if dullness is your bigger concern
- I'd choose this over jumping straight to 20–30%.

**🥉 Budget alternative: Deconstruct Glowing Skin Serum**
### [Deconstruct Glowing Skin Serum]()
*₹262*

### The important part: sunscreen

For dark spots, vitamin C **without daily sunscreen is fighting an uphill battle**. Use the serum in the morning, followed by a broad-spectrum **SPF 50+**, and reapply when you're outdoors. Consistent sun protection is one of the most important factors in fading pigmentation. [www.whowhatwear.com](https://www.whowhatwear.com/beauty/skin/best-products-for-hyperpigmentation?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Simple routine:**  
Morning → gentle cleanser → vitamin C → moisturizer → SPF 50+

Start **3–4 mornings/week**, then increase to daily if your skin is comfortable. If the serum becomes noticeably dark orange/brown, it may have oxidized and should generally be replaced. **If you tell me your skin type (oily/dry/combination/sensitive), approximate budget (₹500/₹1,000/₹2,000+), and whether your dark spots are acne marks or sun pigmentation, I can narrow it down to one serum.**

sources.snippet:
This article from Who What Wear UK provides a comprehensive guide to the best skincare products for treating hyperpigmentation, featuring insights from dermatologists and skin experts. Hyperpigmentation, a common skin concern caused by excess melanin, can result from sun exposure, hormonal changes (such as pregnancy-related melasma), inflammation, or acne scarring. The guide emphasizes that the cause of pigmentation determines the best treatment and underlines the importance of daily SPF use as the most critical step in both prevention and treatment.

Recommended ingredients include vitamin C, niacinamide, azelaic acid, tranexamic acid, and retinoids, which can be found in both over-the-counter and prescription products. Experts caution that results typically take 6 to 12 weeks, or even months, and consistency in skincare is essential.

The article highlights 13 carefully selected products, spanning cleansers, serums, moisturizers, and SPFs. Notable mentions include La Roche-Posay Mela B3 Cleanser, Eucerin Pigment Control SPF50+, The Ordinary Azelaic Acid 10%, and Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum. Each product is chosen based on expert input, performance, ingredient quality, and user reviews, providing practical options for anyone tackling dark spots and uneven skin tone.
